confident.dialogue.chat: Conversation with me? Wise choice. People pay for this in some villages, %1$s.
confident.dialogue.chat/1: An excellent choice, talking to me. The most interesting company you'll keep today.
confident.dialogue.chat/2: I've always time for someone with taste this good, %1$s.
confident.dialogue.conversations: You've come to the right person, %1$s. Ask away — I give excellent answers.
confident.dialogue.conversations/1: You chose your company well today. Go on — I don't rattle easy.
confident.dialogue.conversations/2: Speak up. I've an answer for most things and a fine bluff for the rest.
confident.dialogue.conversations.checkin: Splendidly, of course. The bread rose, the fence held, and the week went precisely as I intended.
Magnificent. I usually am — it's a discipline, %1$s.
Better than most, worse than I'll be tomorrow. I improve on schedule.
A difficult stretch. Not a defeat — a delay. Though I'll admit, %1$s, your asking helps the schedule.
A hard patch. Even I get them — I simply get through them louder.
Asked and answered, %1$s. My good mood needs no encore.
Twice? I'm flattered. Still standing tall, still your favorite.
confident.dialogue.conversations.day.goo: Exactly as planned. Cold well water, short line at the smith, sun on time. The day knows better than to cross me.
Three decisions before noon, all correct. A typical morning.
confident.dialogue.conversations.day.rou: The day is misbehaving. It will come around by supper. They always do when I'm involved.
Rough edges. Nothing I can't file smooth by dusk. Watch me.
confident.dialogue.conversations.work.li: Naturally. I'm the best at it for three villages in any direction, and that is a simple statement of fact.
Love it — there's nothing like being very good at a thing and knowing it.
confident.dialogue.conversations.work.ha: Between us — the work is beneath me. I do it flawlessly anyway. Standards are standards.
The easy days waste me. Bring a real challenge and see what I do with it.
confident.dialogue.conversations.village: %2$s is fortunate to have me. I like to think I raise the average considerably.
%2$s knows me and I know %2$s. Ask anyone — they'll point you my way, smiling.
They adore me, mostly. The holdouts are simply jealous, which is its own kind of praise.
Good people. Half come to ME for advice — which I give freely and, naturally, correctly.
confident.dialogue.conversations.food.fi: The finest the inn offers. They save the best cut for me; reputation has its perks.
Whatever's boldest on the board. I've a strong palate, like everything else about me.
confident.dialogue.conversations.life.fi: A fine story, saved for the right audience. It begins with a stubborn child who was right about nearly everything.
I never once doubted I'd amount to something. I was right. I usually am.
I don't dream, %1$s — I plan. And the plan is a house on the hill everyone said couldn't be built. Watch me.
My name outlasting the wall and the well both. Grand? Yes. Beyond me? Never.
confident.dialogue.conversations.fears.f: You'll keep this quiet. I fear being ordinary. Waking up one morning as just another face at the well.
Being seen to fall. I hide it well — that's rather the point, %1$s.
confident.dialogue.conversations.feeling: I have excellent taste, %1$s, and I've decided you're worth keeping around. Take that as the honor it is.
You don't fawn, and that's exactly why I can't stop looking your way.
confident.dialogue.conversations.deflect: That answer is reserved for my inner circle. Small circle. Excellent view. Earn your seat.
I'm an open book about my triumphs. The rest has a cover charge. Keep visiting.
Even I don't hand that answer to just anyone, %1$s. Prove yourself first. I suspect you will.
That one stays locked till you've earned the key. You're close.
Nothing worth my attention this week. When something happens, I'll know it first. I always do.
Quiet week. Give it time — the interesting things happen where I'm standing.
confident.dialogue.conversations.us.happ: Happiest I've been — and I don't hand out superlatives. You did that, %1$s. Well done.
I chose you over everyone and I never second-guess. Best decision I ever made.
Called it months ago — %2$s and %3$s are married. I'm never wrong about these things, %1$s.
%2$s and %3$s wed at last. A fine match, and yes, I predicted it. I usually do.
%2$s and %3$s have split. Saw that coming a mile off — some pairings simply lack my staying power.
So %2$s and %3$s are done. Pity. Not everyone has the sense to hold onto a good thing, as I do.
Grim news, %1$s. %2$s is gone. A real loss — and I don't say that of many. The village is smaller for it.
We've lost %2$s. Even I've no clever line for that. Good soul. They'll be missed, and that's the truth.
%2$s was born this week — and mark my words, that child's going places. I've an eye for these things.
A new arrival: little %2$s. Healthy, strong, destined for something. You heard it here first.
%2$s has moved into the village. Smart of them, really — best address in three villages, now that I'm in it.
New neighbor, %2$s. I'll introduce myself properly. They'll be glad to know me — they always are.
%2$s has left for good. Their loss, frankly — but I wish them well out there.
Heard %2$s moved on. The village dims a shade without them. Still, we'll manage. We always do.
confident.dialogue.chatmode.confused: You'll have to do better than that, %1$s. Once more.
confident.dialogue.chatmode.confused/1: That meant nothing. Try again — I'll wait.
confident.dialogue.chatmode.hint: Ask me about %2$s. I give excellent answers.
confident.dialogue.chatmode.hint/1: %2$s — pick one; you won't be disappointed.
confident.dialogue.chatmode.shrug: Even I don't have an answer to that. Savor the moment.
confident.dialogue.chatmode.clarify: %2$s or %3$s? Choose — both are worth your time.
confident.dialogue.chatmode.busy: I'm in the middle of something important. Naturally.
confident.dialogue.chatmode.muted: As you wish. My silence is also excellent.
confident.dialogue.chatmode.muted/1: Very well. You'll miss my voice.
confident.dialogue.chatmode.farewell: Off you go, %1$s. You know where the best conversation in town lives.
confident.dialogue.chatmode.farewell/1: Until next time — and there will be one.
confident.dialogue.chatmode.insult: Cute. I've been called worse by better.
confident.dialogue.chatmode.hail: %1$s. Good taste, coming to see me.
confident.dialogue.chatmode.hail/2: There you are. I was starting to think you'd forgotten who's worth talking to.
confident.dialogue.conversations.day.rou: It is. And you said so plainly instead of dressing it up, which I'll remember.
confident.dialogue.conversations.checkin: The wood, then. Tuesday. I don't ask twice, so I'm glad you answered the first time.
confident.dialogue.conversations.work.fo: ...It is. I'd not have admitted that to anyone who asked less directly.
confident.dialogue.conversations.fears.o: You'll stand with me. Good. I'd have done it alone, but I'd rather not, and that's new.
confident.dialogue.conversations.hopes.r: You waited me out. That takes more nerve than interrupting does.
confident.dialogue.conversations.life.re: I told you about my life. I've decided you get the rest of it, and I don't decide that often.
